About.Feedback.Text: Something went wrong, or you have an idea? Write to us. The letter already holds the version and the system, and your mail program shows it before anything is sent.
About.License.Text: RCynQ is free software under the GNU GPL, version 3 or later: you may use, study, share and change it. It comes without any warranty. Components of other authors keep their own licenses.
About.Slogan: Ship your code to a remote machine.

Diag.Neighbours.Fix: Start the transport of the link or check the network and the neighbour's sshd.
Diag.Repo.MissingFix: Add the Git repository on the Branches tab, or with 'rcynq repo add <name> <path>'.

Diag.Snapshot.Missing: The node has no sync base.

Diag.Snapshot.NoHashFix: Run 'status' once to record the state, or recreate the manual baseline.
Diag.SshClient.InstallFix: Install the OpenSSH client and make sure 'ssh' is on PATH (or set SyncBridge:Ssh:SshExecutable).

Diag.Timeout: The check timed out after {0:0} s.

Diag.Transports.NotInBuild: {0}: transport {1} is not available in this build
